item.title: The Percentages: A Biography of Class
item.description: If you have some time, read the article The Percentages: A Biography of Class at Tiger Beatdown. It discusses the we are the 99% slogan of the Occupy Wall Street movement. The author uses a personal story to portray the complexity of class division and classification . She emphasises the solidarity of the 99%, whilst dismissing the uniformity that underpins such division.
